body: The first deposit was a bit of a hassle, but once I'd deposited, buying the coupon was instant! Great value!

When I visited a Korean clinic through GuideKim, I got points back, and I exchange those points for JPYC and use them to buy a 10,000 won DAISO voucher. Paying with JPYC adds 22% off, so what I built up at the clinic grows even bigger. That feeling of shopping at DAISO without spending anything extra is hard to find anywhere else.
At a DAISO in Seoul I paid just by holding up my phone. Paying with JPYC saves over 20%, and as a student that discount is pretty big for me. It was hassle-free👍

Topping up JPYC was a first for me, and honestly that part alone gave me trouble. I followed the guide and it took close to 30 minutes. But once I'd bought the voucher, everything after that was surprisingly simple, and at the register I just showed my phone screen. I used 10,000 won, and compared with paying in exchanged cash, getting 22% off with JPYC alone makes a big difference to the household budget. Get past that first top-up and the rest is smooth.

I go to Korea fairly often, so shopping there is a treat every time. What led me to JPYC this time was trying to enter GuideKim's gift campaign. At my age I'm a little slow to take on new procedures, but once the linking was done, all that was left was a DAISO voucher code arriving at the discounted amount. I almost thought, wait, that's it? Over there I browsed around for daily goods and household items, and paid just by pulling up my phone screen. It's also perfect for small souvenirs, and I almost regret having avoided it as something that looked difficult😊
